name: Credit Default Swap
definition: Credit default swap is a particular type of swap designed to transfer the credit exposure of fixed income products between two or more parties.

RollDate.name: Roll Date
RollDate.definition: Roll date of the underlying asset as established by the asset issuer.

RollMonth.name: Roll Month
RollMonth.definition: Roll month of the underlying asset as established by the asset issuer.

Series.name: Series
Series.definition: Series number of the composition of the derivative if applicable.
